summary: RFC-0054 OQ-15: how GitHub reaches the laptop-local webhook receiver

options.description: gh webhook forward owned by cli-hierarchy up/down; forwarder is a config value, tunnels as external
Tailscale Funnel, stable ts.net URL, hook registered by hand
Cloudflare Tunnel as the ops doc chose; account, zone, cloudflared service

body: OQ-1 chose webhook-first, OQ-8 laptop-local, OQ-10 trigger-only; the last hop from GitHub to 127.0.0.1 was undecided and AISDLC-880 shipped with the choice made in an ops doc, two wake-file names and no scheduler launcher. Full rubric in the RFC (OQ-15, 2026-10-15).
